loadError: Could not load the mail center.
protectedLayout: The default layout cannot be deleted.
masterOff: Sending is off — no emails will be sent
policyHint: Disabled events never send mail, even if a module requests it. Sending limits are enforced on the server.
subject: Message subject
intervalHint: Two emails for the same event and recipient must be at least this far apart. Set to 0 to disable.
layoutHint: Layouts provide shared branding, a legal footer and an unsubscribe link. Each event’s text appears in its message body block. Saved in
masterHint: When off, all outgoing emails stop, including acknowledgements. Use this for maintenance or delivery problems.
windowHint: The same record and event cannot trigger a second send within this window.
quietHint: No emails are sent during these hours. Blocked sends remain visible in the log.
transactional: Send only one transactional email per step of an order, quote or application.
digest: Group internal alerts into a daily summary rather than sending an email per event.
consent: Newsletters and campaigns require explicit consent and an unsubscribe link.
avoidSpam: Avoid cart reminders, “we miss you” emails and requests for reviews. They can get the domain flagged as spam.
studioHint: Blocks, branding and preview. Saved in data/mail/layouts.json.
inUse: Layout in use by {count} event(s). Assign them a different layout first.
unknownVars: Unknown variables for this event: {list}. They will be sent as empty values.
hint_order_shipped: When the order is marked as shipped.
hint_order_delivered: When the order is marked as delivered.
hint_order_payment: When a payment is matched to the order.
hint_quotes: Follow a quote from sending to acceptance.
hint_quote_sent: When the quote is marked as replied to.
hint_quote_accepted: When a quote is accepted or converted into an order.
hint_quote_expired: One reminder when the quote expires.
hint_contact: Incoming messages from the public site.
hint_contact_received: One email acknowledging the visitor’s message.
hint_contact_alert: Notify the company. Prefer a digest to one email per message.
hint_application_received: One email when an application is submitted.
hint_application_alert: Notify the recruiter. A daily digest is recommended.
hint_newsletter: Mailing list for recipients who explicitly opted in.
hint_newsletter_welcome: One email on signup, including an unsubscribe link.
hint_newsletter_campaign: Send only to subscribed addresses with consent.
hint_user_welcome: One email when an account is created.
hint_user_password_reset: A single-use link sent only at the user’s request.
hint_stock_backorder: One email per out-of-stock product for the affected order.
